summary: Third-generation lookout on its site (original 1931 pole tower, 1953 L-4, present 1980 flat-cab tower), still staffed each fire season.

facts.design: 41 ft timber tower, R-6/flat cab with catwalk (built 1980)
facts.status_note: Current structure is the third tower on this site; earlier log cabin from the 1931 build still stands.

access.note: Active, staffed Forest Service lookout; drive-up per idahofirelookouts.com, not a public rental

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (Nez Perce National Forest, Salmon River Ranger District)

events.note: First structure: pole tower with L-6 cab (45 ft per NHLR/firelookout.com, 65 ft per idahofirelookouts.com), plus log cabin
41 ft timber tower with L-4 cab replaced the original pole tower
Present 41 ft timber tower with flat (R-6) cab and catwalk went into service
Registered on NHLR April 24, 2009, nominated by Gary Weber
Teepee Springs Fire approached; tower and cabin wrapped in protective foil, fire did not reach the structure

evidence.supports: Three-tower history, 1953 and 1980 replacements, log cabin still standing, NHLR registration date
evidence.quote: The first structure at Chair Point Lookout on the Nez Perce National Forest was a log cabin which is still there. The accompanying 45' log tower with a L-6 cab was replaced in 1953 with an L-4 cab on a 41' timber tower. The present R-6 flat cab with catwalk on a 41' timber tower went into service in 1980.

evidence.supports: 1931 build date (65 ft pole tower), staffing records, 2015 fire/foil wrap
evidence.quote:
Chair Point Lookout was built in 1931 – a 65' pole L-6 cabin.
1953 – 41' TT L-4 cab was built.
1980 – 41' TT Flat cab was built.
2009 – Added to The National Historic Lookout Register
Chair Point lookout is staffed every fire season.
The tower and cabin were wrapped in protective foil in 2015 due to the advancing Teepee Springs fire. Luckily, the fire did not reach the tower.

evidence.supports: Pole tower replaced 1953, flat cab tower 1980, location (6 miles northeast of Riggins) and elevation
evidence.quote: A 45' pole L-6 tower and accompanying log cabin (still there), built in 1931, were replaced by a 41' treated timber L-4 tower in 1953. ... Nez Perce National Forest. 6 miles northeast of Riggins. Idaho County, Idaho. Elevation 6951'

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief's 'built: 1980' reflects only the current flat-cab tower; idahofirelookouts.com and firelookout.com both date the original lookout structure on this site to 1931, which NHLR's own description implies (describing a 'first structure') without stating a year.
NHLR and firelookout.com both give the original (1931) pole tower as 45 ft; idahofirelookouts.com gives 65 ft for the same structure. Story notes both figures rather than picking one.

notes_for_editor: Consider updating the record's 'built' field or adding a note that 1980 is the current tower's build year, with the site's lookout history going back to 1931.
